name: Rosengarten (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rosengarten (a black horse above a rose with oak leaves on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Rosengarten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rosengarten arms — horse and rose on yellow
